description: Notify the init system about service status updates.

option.name: --booted
tip: Check whether the system was booted with systemd.

option.name: --exec
tip: Execute the command line after notification.

option.name: --fd
tip: Pass the file descriptor with the message.

option.name: --fdname
tip: Assign a name to passed file descriptors.

option.name: --no-block
tip: Do not wait for the operation to finish.

option.name: --pid
tip: Set the main PID of the daemon.

option.name: --ready
tip: Report service start-up or reload completion.

option.name: --uid
tip: Set the user to send from.
